command.text: declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &VisibleFieldGridDetailShowing; select @message as message return

declare @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32), @taxRate numeric(28, 6) select @taxRate = 0, @taxAccount = '', @taxType = 0, @taxCode = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_thue_0' if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @taxCode) select @taxRate = a.thue_suat, @taxAccount = rtrim(a.tk_thue_co), @taxType = isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_co = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @taxCode
select 'var t=this;t._taxCode =''' + rtrim(@taxCode) + ''';t._taxRate =''' + rtrim(@taxRate) + ''';t._taxAccount =''' + rtrim(@taxAccount) + ''';t._taxType =' + rtrim(@taxType) + ';t._voucherCode='@@id';load$GridVoucherDetail$(t);t.$a.AmountFormula=t.$a.&AmountFormula;;&Clipboard.Loading.Ext;' as message return
declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' select @message = @message + 'setDefaultValue$GridVoucherDetail(this.get_element().parentForm);' select @message as message return

query.text: select @@fieldExternal from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmtk b on a.tk_dt = b.tk left join dmtk c on a.tk_thue = c.tk&ESG.queryLoading; where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause
